properties.description:
Conduct a needs-analysis session with the user about the existing reusable filter UI component, starting from its use in the Repositories pane of Review → Changes. Clarify the filtering workflows, query creation/editing, saved queries and query composition that the user needs, and what feels difficult in the current component. Ask one question at a time and record each question and the user's answer word for word in a dedicated Markdown transcript. Separate agreed needs from undecided design choices. This task does not authorize replacing the component or implementing an assumed design.

Current sequencing: finish the filtering needs analysis and prepare the filtering upgrade first. Search presentation is a separate task near the end of the MVP, after filtering works. Focus this first phase on shared query/operator responsibilities, reflection-driven field and operator discovery across views, agent query/discovery access, manual application, and saved query references. Contributor-specific convenience operators and Ctrl+F/focus work are outside this MVP scope. Preserve the interview and later clarifications in .harness/design/search-filter-needs-analysis.md; unresolved traversal depth is not an accepted design.
properties.title: Analyze needs for the filter UI component
